نحتسي (form VIII)
# نَحْتَسِي (naḥtasī) /naħ.ta.siː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# نَحْتَسِيَ (naḥtasiya) /naħ.ta.si.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
